verdict.rationale: Mercury's API docs explicitly point AI agents to https://docs.mercury.com/llms.txt, which indexes all pages in Markdown with endpoints in OpenAPI, and appending .md to any docs page returns a markdown version. A probe confirmed llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with that content, and many cited docs pages are served as .md. An official Agent Skills repo with SKILL.md files adds further agent-oriented material. Missing for 10: no OpenAPI spec at standard discoverable paths (all probed openapi/swagger URLs returned 404), and no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs.
